text: Semiconductor shares decline across U.S., European, and Asian markets. Micron falls 5%, SK Hynix over 10%, Samsung 7.4%, and SoftBank 8.5%. CXMT reports progress in memory density architecture; large-scale production capability remains unverified.

meta.note: Market declines are observable; relative contributions from competition, financing, and positioning remain unresolved.

text: Paul Tudor Jones outlines a bearish 2027 equity outlook, citing anticipated technology IPOs, secondary issuance, fiscal deficits, and elevated yields. He contrasts prior buyback-driven equity supply reductions with prospective issuance and reports a short-market positioning preference.

meta.note: Projected issuance, market declines, and fiscal adjustments remain forecasts rather than observed conditions.
